<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a strong M+2 peak at ~33 % of the base peak and a very small M+4 peak—this matches the characteristic distribution of chlorine (35Cl/37Cl). No other element shows a definitive pattern (e.g., bromine would give an M+2 ≈ 100 %). Therefore, chlorine is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
